title: Negotiation Screens: Round Cap, Search, Chat

Negotiation.dc.html.title: Live negotiation: round 2 of 3, with chat

t1.text: Day 1 designs: 3-round cap, search tab, chatbox

s1.text: Rules these screens follow: 1) The engine, not the AI, enforces price limits. 2) Maximum 3 rounds. 3) One active negotiation per seller. 4) Chat can discuss scope but never change the price. 5) Nobody sees the other side's limit.
